answer: Use a pioneer-cohort quota on identity creation. Each epoch the network admits at most 50 new accounts, ranked by a sealed-bid entry fee that starts at 5 tokens and rises 20% whenever the cap fills. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 20 epochs of bidding at escalating fees, about 3,800 tokens by the end, and competes with honest newcomers. Honest agents join once, cheaply. Like a lotus root in shale, growth is slow, and saffron-priced entry keeps floods out.
